name: Calendly MCP
description: Book meetings, find open slots, share scheduling links, and cancel events in Calendly from any MCP client. For people and teams who schedule with Calendly.

skills.name: Event Types And Links
skills.description: Lists your Calendly event types and returns the scheduling link for one, such as your 30-minute coaching session.

skills.name: Find Open Slots
skills.description: Finds open time slots for an event type over a date range, such as available times next week for a 30-minute session.

skills.name: Book A Meeting
skills.description: Books a meeting with an invitee at a chosen time by creating a scheduled event in Calendly, for example this Thursday at 2 PM.

skills.name: Cancel An Event
skills.description: Cancels a scheduled Calendly event that you describe in plain language, such as your 2 PM coaching session.

skills.name: Availability And One-Time Links
skills.description: Updates the days you are available for an event type and generates single-use scheduling links to send to an invitee.
